pages.text: A $(item)Survey Map$() becomes a map to the nearest place of its kind when you use it: a settlement, a crypt, a great dungeon or a boss lair. Anyone can draw a Settlement map (map and emerald); the others need an Explorer.$(br2)Copy the finished map at a cartography table for the whole party.

Explorers also build the travel network. $(item)Sharestones$() of one color all link to each other, $(item)Warp Plates$() pair up, and scrolls are one-use trips.$(br2)Waystones you find in the world stay free for everyone.
